findings.defect: Swept parent clearance leaves a thin unsupported rear canopy
findings.evidence: Front view shows broad lower undercut under the convex rim; wall regions 167.6 mm2 at (3.6,-16.9,2.9) and 17.0 mm2 at (1.2,-11.9,1.0), minimum0.20mm; unsupported325.9mm2 at (0.1,-12.9,1.4).
findings.repair: Project the rear-most parent-clearance section back to the print seam to remove the canopy while retaining the lower barrel and socket; assess the residual seam width before applying this rear-specific construction.

observation: Front, top and iso inspected. Rear body retains convex barrel flank, four slotted socket fingers, open mouth and symmetric ankle corners. Front view exposes a broad undercut below the raised upper edge; the swept parent clearance has left a thin unsupported canopy. Wish measurement identifies two sub-1.2 wall regions, and overhang measurement finds a broad unsupported region.
